monogr.title: Comprehensive Coverage: The subquestions should comprehensively address all relevant aspects of the claim to enable a thorough fact-check
Ensure there is no overlap between the subquestions. Each question should be unique in meaning and not semantically repetitive
Every question must be relevant in determining the veracity of the claim. Avoid irrelevant or tangential questions
Clarity and Grammar: Write questions that are clean, concise, and grammatically correct to maintain clarity
